**MEMO CONTENT (Text Version)**

**To:** Management
**From:** Quality Auditor
**Date:** October 11, 2026
**Subject:** TCO Analysis: Diesel vs. Battery-Electric Class 8 Tractors

**Executive Summary**
It is recommended that the carrier **do not** replace the current diesel fleet with battery-electric tractors at this time. Based on the 7-year total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis, the battery-electric option is $169,200 more expensive per truck than the diesel alternative.

**TCO Comparison Table (Per Truck)**

| Cost Category | Diesel | Battery-Electric (BEV) | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Purchase Price (Net) | $180,000 [unverified] | $360,000 [unverified] | BEV includes $40k Fed credit [unverified] |
| Infrastructure | $0 | $153,000 [S10] | Per-truck share of depot CAPEX |
| Energy/Fuel (7-Year) | $231,000 [unverified] | $92,400 [unverified] | 420k miles total |
| Maintenance (7-Year) | $63,000 [unverified] | $37,800 [unverified] | 420k miles total |
| **Total 7-Year TCO** | **$474,000** | **$643,200** | **BEV Premium: $169,200** |

**Detailed Assumptions**
- **Annual Mileage:** 60,000 miles per truck (Total 420,000 miles over 7 years).
- **Diesel Efficiency:** 7.0 MPG [S2, 2026].
- **BEV Efficiency:** 2.0 kWh/mile [S2, 2026].
- **Energy Pricing:** Diesel at $3.85/gal [unverified, Oct 2026]; Electricity at $0.11/kWh [unverified, Oct 2026].
- **Infrastructure:** Total depot cost of $3,060,000 [S10, 2026] allocated across 20 trucks.
- **Maintenance:** Diesel at $0.15/mi [unverified]; BEV at $0.09/mi [unverified].
- **Residual Value:** No salvage value attributed to either vehicle type at year 7.

**Sources**
- [S2] Comparing Electric Truck Performance to Diesel Models (FleetRabbit, 2026)
- [S10] Commercial EV Charging Station Cost: Installation Guide for 2026 (GreenLancer, 2026)
- [unverified] Various market benchmarks provided in Step 1.
